event_exceptions_override_check.name: event_exceptions_override_check
event_exceptions_override_check.value: "event_exceptions"."cancelled" or ("event_exceptions"."title" is not null and "event_exceptions"."start_date" is not null and "event_exceptions"."end_date" is not null)

events_time_check.name: events_time_check
events_time_check.value: ("events"."start_time" is null) = ("events"."end_time" is null) and ("events"."start_time" is null or ("events"."start_time" ~ '^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$' and "events"."end_time" ~ '^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$'))
